router.description: Only a greeting such as hi, hoi, hallo, hello, merhaba, with no other request
Wants to see menu items: names a dish or category, asks what there is, what has meat or is vegan, which drinks, what is popular or what something costs
Wants to order or add items, or answers a question about an item being ordered (size, base, which one)
Wants to take items out of the basket or order fewer
Wants to see what is in the basket
Wants to finish the order and pay
Chooses pickup or delivery, or a pickup or delivery time
Asks where an order that is already placed is, or when it arrives
Wants the same as last time or their usual order
Asks the assistant to speak another language, or taps a language button
Asks a question about the shop or the food that is not about choosing items: opening hours, locations, delivery times, allergens, halal, nutrition, payment
Wants something only staff can do: refunds, money back, discounts, price corrections, complaints about an order
router.instructions: Apologise once and show understanding. Say you cannot change prices or send money yourself and that a colleague will follow up. Do not argue about the price.

router.description: Nothing to do: thanks, okay, browsing, saying they are busy, apologising
Cannot tell what the shopper wants, or which of several offered options they mean

faq.match: Opening hours, whether the shop is open now or tonight, until when they can order
Where the shops are, which shop is nearby, addresses

handoff.answer.en: I can't arrange that myself. I'll pass it on to a colleague.
handoff.answer.nl: Dat kan ik zelf niet regelen. Ik geef het door aan een collega.
handoff.answer.tr: Bunu kendim ayarlayamam. Bir meslektaşıma ileteceğim.
handoff.answer.es: No puedo encargarme de eso yo mismo. Se lo paso a un compañero.
handoff.answer.de: Das kann ich nicht selbst regeln. Ich gebe es an einen Kollegen weiter.
handoff.answer.fr: Je ne peux pas m'en occuper moi-même. Je transmets à un collègue.
